location.title: Location is off for this app. Here's how to turn it on.
location.android1: Open Chrome and tap the three dots at the top right, then Settings.
location.android4: In your phone's Settings, open Apps, then Chrome, then Permissions, then Location. Choose Allow only while using the app and turn on Use precise location.
location.iphone1: Open Settings, then Privacy & Security, then Location Services.
location.iphone2: Make sure Location Services is on.
location.iphone3: Scroll down to Safari Websites and choose While Using the App.

precise.title: Your phone is sharing only an approximate location. Here's how to share the exact one.
precise.android1: In your phone's Settings, open Apps, then Chrome, then Permissions, then Location.
precise.iphone1: Open Settings, then Privacy & Security, then Location Services.
precise.iphone2: Tap Safari Websites and turn on Precise Location.

camera.title: Camera is off for this app. Here's how to turn it on.
camera.android1: Open Chrome and tap the three dots at the top right, then Settings.
camera.android4: In your phone's Settings, open Apps, then Chrome, then Permissions, then Camera, and choose Allow.
camera.iphone1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Safari.
camera.iphone2: Tap Camera and choose Allow or Ask.

notifications.title: Notifications are off. Here's how to turn them on.
notifications.android1: In your phone's Settings, open Apps, then Chrome, then Notifications, and turn them on.
notifications.android2: Open Chrome, tap the three dots, then Settings, then Site settings, then Notifications.

privacy.lead: Feelings Beauty Care uses this app to record attendance and pay. Here is what it keeps and why.
privacy.p1: Your name, phone number, role and salary details, which {{owner}} enters. Each check-in and check-out: the time from our server, whether you were inside the salon or a venue, and how far you were. A photo only if the salon asks for one.
privacy.p2: Only when you tap Check in or Check out. We never track you in the background and keep no route history.
privacy.p3: Exact locations for {{location}} days, selfies for {{selfie}} days. Attendance and pay records for the years the law asks.
privacy.p4: {{owner}} and anyone she allows to manage attendance. We do not sell or share your data.
privacy.p5: You can see your data in My data, ask for a correction, and ask {{owner}} any question about it.
privacy.selfieOn: You agreed to a photo when you check in. You can take that back.
privacy.selfieOff: You took back your photo consent on {{date}}.
privacy.selfieNever: You haven't been asked for a photo.
privacy.withdrawConfirm: Stop sharing a photo when you check in? {{owner}} may ask you to check in another way.
